name: How long does it take to install accessible flooring in a typical Bay Area home?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install accessible flooring in a typical Bay Area home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration for accessible flooring installation depends on several factors, including the type of flooring material, the total square footage, the condition of the existing subfloor, and whether old flooring needs to be removed. For a single room, installation might take 1-3 days. For an entire house, especially if significant subfloor preparation or removal of old materials is required, it could extend to 5-10 business days or more. Your contractor from City Dweller, LLC will provide a project timeline specific to your home in the Bay Area, considering all these variables.
acceptedAnswer.description: Accessible flooring installation in the Bay Area varies from 1-3 days for a single room to 5-10+ days for a whole house, depending on material, size, and subfloor prep.
